# JSTNURMIND

> JSTNURMIND (pronounced "Just In Your Mind") is a red-masked, underground multi-genre music producer and artist. Styles range between alternative hip-hop, rap, house, and techno. Originally from New York City, currently based in Austin, Texas.

Official website: https://jstnurmind.com
